result.title: Improving Category-Aware Active Domain Adaptation via Uncertainty-Guided Region Coverage
result.comment: Accepted at Machine Learning Journal through ACML Journal Track 2026
result.summary: Active domain adaptation researches focus on alleviating the annotation cost, which comprises source data and target data labelling, as well as enhancing the performance of unsupervised domain adaptation. However, optimizing the adaptation model based on the average accuracy can lead to the drop in performance of some difficult categories. To overcome this issue, a point-wise selection strategy built upon the influence function can be used to improve domain adaptation performance. In our work, we first address the sensitive and redundant aspects of point-wise selection, which can lead to overfitting of the acquisition function. We thus introduce a region-based approach that ensures the improvement of the adaptation model by maximizing a positive manifold coverage. An uncertainty score is further introduced to the selection mechanism to learn a better decision boundary for the target domain. In comprehensive experiments, our proposed method surpasses the first category-aware active domain adaptation baseline as well as existing active domain adaptation methods across multiple domain adaptation benchmarks. Our implementation is available at: https://github.com/nhtm2702/WHO IS NEXT.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究类别感知的主动域自适应，指出逐点选取易敏感、冗余并导致采集函数过拟合，转而提出基于区域覆盖的选取策略，并引入不确定性分数以改善目标域决策边界，在多个域自适应基准上超过原有基线。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「不确定性引导的区域覆盖」选取思路或可启发 LVR 中视觉证据/区域的筛选与主动获取方式，可供核查；但该工作面向域自适应的标注采样，与推理期 latent 状态生成无直接关系。
